poster.alt: Time Series Anomaly Detector poster: Z-Score and IQR statistical detection methods for monitoring dashboards

card1.alt: Z-Score method card: distance in standard deviations from the rolling mean; Z=3 covers 0.3% of normal distribution

card2.alt: IQR method card: Interquartile Range flags points beyond 1.5 times the middle 50% spread; x > Q3+1.5*IQR or x < Q1-1.5*IQR

card3.alt: Why statistical beats static thresholds: a 500ms alert does not know that yesterday averaged 180ms; the Z-Score adapts to natural range and volatility
